This is a planning warning about matrix feasibility, not a PTQ1 measurement or speed verdict. Promotion needs at least 10 percent lower end-to-end latency or reviewed capacity/energy benefit within accepted latency and quality limits.

Full context/output, long/generated/edited history, active cancellation/full-state recovery, backend loss, restricted identity and broker-only communication, speech/offline recovery, actual-model resource/paging behavior, clean-machine installation/rollback, independent creative quality and owner-accepted sustained comfort remain independent.
